Azure AD login migrated to MSAL: user search roles now derive from homeAccountId/username, and token refresh uses silent acquisition, changing permission-filtered results.
Search operation documented; contract says nothing about Azure AD identity attributes used for role/permission filtering.
Page numbers below 1 are clamped to 1 and negative page sizes to 0 instead of being rejected.
Only OpenAPI generator config files exist; no API description. Affects all paged list endpoints.
Listing commits with a non-existent sha now returns 404 instead of 500.
No checked-in contract document exists at the parent commit.
Implicit subscriptions are now created even when the user already has an inherited (parent project) subscription.
Contract documents explicit subscribe/unsubscribe only; implicit subscription on task actions not described.
Non-HTTPS return_url on a live account now yields 422 with error code P0920 and a return_url-specific message.
422 documented only with a description-length example; request return_url has no HTTPS constraint and P0920 is absent.
Async operation bindings gain a routingKey field in service/operation representations.
Binding schema lists type, keyType, destinationType, destinationName, qoS, persistent; no routingKey.
Endpoint descriptors now build href from callback address/server path plus prefix, derive interface names, and add subprotocol fields.
No contract; descriptors appear to be published to registries rather than served by a specific endpoint.
Recent time-series values requested by ts-ids are now filtered by the given office.
Import returns 400 for empty file, 415 for non-JSON content type and 500 on import failure, instead of always 201.
Contract documents only the 201 response; no error statuses for invalid uploads.
Stopping scan-all now marks the execution stopped so no further artifact scans are submitted; errors are returned to the caller.
Description only 'Stop scanAll job execution'; nothing on halting pending artifact enumeration.
